best_hook.why: A thug violently shoves the bandaged heroine onto the wet stone path; sudden violence against a defenceless woman stops the scroll.

best_cliffhanger.why: Alexander stands between Juliana and three armed thugs and the leader taunts 'You want to fight us, veteran?'; the fight has not started yet.

must_promos.why: Snarled 'Get out of the way!', her defiant 'No.', then the shove within 3 s; blood seeps through her bandages, thugs laugh, a club is raised, her husband charges out of the mist and the clip cuts on the standoff.

Opens on a club smashing a planter at night, follows the full garden desecration and the shove, and cuts with the club raised over her mother's last herbs and Juliana screaming 'Stop!', before any rescue.

standalone_risk: Nothing in the clip says who sent the thugs or why, why her hands are bandaged, or that Alexander is her husband; 'veteran' is the only hint about him.
notes: Promo 2 runs close to the 60 s cap; if trimmed, the first cut would be the 'clearing this rubbish' exchange.
